pairs: Ostendit mihi Dominus:
The Lord revealed to me,
et ecce duo calathi pleni ficis, positi ante templum Domini,
and behold, two baskets full of figs were set before the temple of the Lord,
postquam transtulit Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis Jechoniam filium Joakim,
after Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon, carried away Jeconiah,
regem Juda, et principes ejus,
the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah,
et fabrum,
and his leaders,
et inclusorem, de Jerusalem,
and the craftsmen and engravers of Jerusalem,
et adduxit eos in Babylonem.
and led them into Babylon.
Calathus unus ficus bonas habebat nimis,
One basket had exceedingly good figs,
ut solent ficus esse primi temporis:
like the figs usually found early in the season,
et calathus unus ficus habebat malas nimis,
and the other basket had exceedingly bad figs,
quæ comedi non poterant eo quod essent malæ.
which could not be eaten because they were so bad.
Et dixit Dominus ad me:
And the Lord said to me:
Quid tu vides,
“What do you see,
Jeremia?
Jeremiah?”
Et dixi:
And I said:
Ficus,
“Figs:
ficus bonas, bonas valde:
the good figs are very good,
et malas, malas valde, quæ comedi non possunt eo quod sint malæ.
and the bad figs are very bad and cannot be eaten because they are so bad.”
Et factum est verbum Domini ad me,
And the word of the Lord came to me,
dicens:
saying:
Hæc dicit Dominus Deus Israël:
“Thus says the Lord,
Sicut ficus hæ bonæ,
the God of Israel:
sic cognoscam transmigrationem Juda,
Just like these good figs,
quam emisi de loco isto in terram Chaldæorum,
so will I regard as good the captives of Judah,
in bonum.
whom I have sent from this place into the land of the Chaldeans.
Et ponam oculos meos super eos ad placandum,
And I will set my eyes upon them, so as to be pleased.
et reducam eos in terram hanc:
And I will lead them back into this land.
et ædificabo eos,
And I will build them up,
et non destruam:
and I will not tear them down.
et plantabo eos,
And I will plant them,
et non evellam.
and I will not uproot them.
Et dabo eis cor ut sciant me,
And I will give them a heart,
quia ego sum Dominus:
so that they may know me,
et erunt mihi in populum,
that I am the Lord. And they will be my people,
et ego ero eis in Deum,
and I will be their God.
quia revertentur ad me in toto corde suo.
For they shall return to me with their whole heart.
Et sicut ficus pessimæ quæ comedi non possunt eo quod sint malæ,
And just like the very bad figs, which cannot be eaten because they are so bad,
hæc dicit Dominus:
thus says the Lord:
Sic dabo Sedeciam regem Juda,
so will I regard Zedekiah, the king of Judah,
et principes ejus,
and his leaders,
et reliquos de Jerusalem,
and the rest of Jerusalem,
qui remanserunt in urbe hac,
those who have remained in this city,
et qui habitant in terra Ægypti.
and those who are living in the land of Egypt.
Et dabo eos in vexationem,
And I will give them over,
afflictionemque omnibus regnis terræ, in opprobrium,
with upheaval and affliction, to all the kingdoms of the earth:
et in parabolam,
to be a disgrace,
et in proverbium,
and a parable, and a proverb,
et in maledictionem in universis locis ad quæ ejeci eos.
and a curse in all the places to which I have cast them out.
Et mittam in eis gladium,
And I will send among them the sword,
et famem,
and famine,
et pestem,
and pestilence:
donec consumantur de terra quam dedi eis
until they have been worn away from the land,
et patribus eorum.
which I gave to them and to their fathers.”
